title: Vault Harbour
tagline: Work the docks of a busy harbour where cargo, ledgers and clerks must stay in step, and learn what happens inside a database.

funFacts.text: A hard disk spinning at 7,200 rpm needs about 8.33 milliseconds for one full turn, so on average its data is half a turn away from the read head.
If every node in an index tree points to 100 children, a tree only four steps deep can reach 100 million nodes.
PostgreSQL's planner scores a page read out of order as four times as costly as a page read in order, using its default settings.
Two clerks adding 30 and 50 to a balance of 100 can leave 150 instead of 180, if both read the balance before either writes.

starRules: 3 stars: no mistakes and no hints. 2 stars: up to 2 mistakes. 1 star: you finished.
